info.name: Zetheta Notification Engine API
info.description: Generated from docs/openapi.json by scripts/generate-postman.ts. Run "Auth → Issue access tokens" first.

item.name: Auth
Issue access tokens (password, client_credentials or refresh_token grant)

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', b.accessToken);

item.name: Revoke a refresh token family (logout)
Mint a short-lived USER token for an end user (trusted auth gateway only)
Taxonomy
List registered financial event types
Events
Submit a financial event for asynchronous processing
Submit up to 500 financial events; each item is validated independently
Ingestion status of a batch
Processing status of an event, with resulting notifications and policy decisions
Notifications
List notifications (own for USER tokens; any user for operators via userId)
Get a notification by id
Delivery attempts for a notification (provider, outcome, error classification)
Full state-transition history (with actor, correlation id and reason)
Mark an in-app notification as read (owner only, idempotent)
Record a click on an in-app or push notification (click-through analytics)
Delivery
Delivery status: persisted state plus a live provider status query where supported
Users
Create a (synthetic) user with contact details (encrypted at rest)
Get a user (contact values are masked)
Add or re-activate a contact (phone/email/push token)
Remove a contact
Irreversibly anonymise a user (right to erasure); audited
Preferences
Explicit and effective (resolved) preferences with the source of each value
Update one category (PDF Appendix A shape): channels and digest mode
Enable/disable delivery channels
Enable/disable event categories and per-category channels
Configure digest batching for low-priority categories
Configure quiet hours (minimum 6 hours) and IANA timezone
Set the preferred notification language
Consent
Current consent state per channel/purpose and the full audit history
Record a consent change (append-only ledger with timestamp, source and evidence)
Compliance
Inspect auditable policy decisions (consent, DND, quiet hours, caps, overrides, fallbacks)
Dry-run the routing/compliance pipeline for a user and event type (nothing is sent or consumed)
Import authorised DND registry data or synthetic test fixtures (numbers are hashed, never stored)
Look up the DND classification of a number (POST so the number never appears in URLs/logs)
Templates
List templates (one per event type × channel × locale)
Create a new template version (validated; optionally activated)
All versions of a template (newest first)
Render the active template (or a draft) with sample or supplied data
Activate a template version (previous active version is retired)
Start or stop an A/B test: `percent` of users get `version` (0 stops it)
Webhooks
Delivery receipts from mock/sandbox providers (HMAC-signed)
Delivery/bounce receipts from the SMTP relay (HMAC-signed)
Twilio message status callback (X-Twilio-Signature verified)
MSG91 delivery reports (shared-secret header X-Webhook-Secret)
Meta webhook verification handshake
WhatsApp Cloud API status updates (X-Hub-Signature-256 verified)
DLQ
List dead-letter entries with failure reasons
Dead-letter entry with retry history and delivery attempts
Manually retry a dead-letter entry (fresh retry budget); audited
Resolve (handled out-of-band) or discard (ADMIN only) a dead-letter entry; audited
Operations
RabbitMQ queue depths, Kafka consumer lag, outbox backlog and open DLQ entries
Provider configuration, circuit-breaker state and quota
Enable/disable a provider or change its failover priority / rate limit; audited
Inject failures into a MOCK provider (disabled outside PROVIDER_MODE=mock)
Run the data-retention scrub now (personalisation older than RETENTION_DAYS); audited
Audit log of privileged operations
Security
Current rate-limit usage for the calling principal
Analytics
Delivery, acceptance and failure rates by channel or event type
P50/P95/P99 send and delivery latency per channel
Read/open and click-through rates where the channel can measure them
Failure rate by provider and top failure reasons
Rolling 30-day opt-out rate
Delivery cost per channel and per delivered notification
Frequency-cap hit rate and open digest suggestions
All analytics in one response
Per-channel delivery, read/click, latency percentiles and cost (PDF Day 10)
Daily opt-outs by channel/category and the rolling 30-day rate (PDF Day 10)
A/B test comparison: delivery, read and click rates per template version
Which preferences users change most often (PDF Day 5)
Delivery and read rates by channel and priority, caps, DND blocks and cost
